target: For every genuine Boolean sign on every finite uniform cube, prove or refute existence of one absolute a>=0 and 0<=b<1 such that G(f)<=a I(f)+b U(f).
candidate: F_n(x,y)=(-1)^(phi_n^{-1}(x) dot y), where phi_n is the median-threshold triangular bijection; physical dimension 2n.

analytic_claim.statement: G_y(F_n)>=n+n^2/1142400 for every n>=131072, conditional on the analytic occupation-time and extension-tail proof.
analytic_claim.scope: GU only; not an FEI counterexample

all_parameter_witness.quantifiers: For every fixed finite a>=0 and 0<=b<1

reduction: The source-reviewed one-way GU-to-FEI implication is H<=(2+2a/(1-b))I; it is not used to infer the GU obstruction.
